title: Falling Through the Earth Takes 38 Minutes
text:
A classic physics thought experiment: in a straight airless tunnel through Earth's center, you would speed up all the way to the core, slow down all the way out, stop at the far surface and fall back again. With Earth's real density, the one-way trip takes about 38 minutes, not the 42 a uniform planet would give. It ignores heat, pressure and Earth's spin.

Follow for more what-ifs that sound impossible.
